name: rego-adventure-frontend
description: Policy-Based Access Control Adventure - Frontend Dependencies
author: Mario Enrico Ragucci

comments.purpose: This package.json tracks CDN dependencies for security scanning only.
comments.deployment: Dependencies are loaded via CDN using Import Maps (see index.html/importmap.json).
comments.security: Run 'npm audit' to check for vulnerabilities in tracked dependencies.
comments.updates: Use 'npm outdated' to check for available updates, then update versions in package.json and regenerate the import map in index.html with cmd/importmapgen (do not edit the import map by hand).
comments.importmap: The optional 'importmap.subpaths' field declares package subpath modules per devDependency; importmapgen emits an extra '<lib>/<subpath>' entry for each. Declare subpaths here when a new import path is used in frontend code.
comments.testing: Run 'npm test' with the pinned vitest toolchain installed ephemeral like in CI: npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund vitest@5.0.0 happy-dom@20.14.3
